A tiny max_image_size does not crash conversion even when the image exceeds the limit

```elixir title="Elixir"
options_value = %HtmlToMarkdown.ConversionOptions{extract_images: true, max_image_size: 10}
result = HtmlToMarkdown.convert("<p>Tiny limit: <img src=\"data:image/png;base64,iVBORw0KGgoAAAANSUhEUgAAAAEAAAABCAYAAAAfFcSJAAAADUlEQVR42mP8/5+hHgAHggJ/PchI7wAAAABJRU5ErkJggg==\" alt=\"pixel\"></p>", options_value)
IO.inspect(result.content)
```
